pattern_description: Multi-card syndicate operating through shared device profile (Windows | Unknown | edge 16.0 | Unknown) across 160 distinct cards and 158 customers, operating behind an anonymous proxy and linked to 1164 prior closed fraud cases.
sar_narrative:
SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY REPORT (SAR) NARRATIVE
Case Reference: HHG-016
Subject Customer: C09988 | Subject Card: C09988-K1
Activity Period: 2016-12-12 01:39:08 | Cumulative Exposure: $59.67
Primary Typology: UNDOCUMENTED

1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY:
Financial institution automated graph surveillance identified organized anomalous activity involving customer C09988 and card C09988-K1, resulting in cumulative suspicious exposure of $59.67 across transaction(s) 3534820.

2. GRAPH & DEVICE TOPOLOGY ANALYSIS:
Graph traversal revealed that transaction 3534820 originated from device profile 'Windows | Unknown | edge 16.0 | Unknown' (Device ID: DEV_4c0f04f45b20). Graph topological queries confirmed this exact device profile is shared across 160 distinct cardholder accounts and is connected to 1164 previously confirmed fraud case(s) (CC-1747, CC-2404, CC-4581, CC-1273). Activity exhibited proxy masking characteristics (Proxy status: ).

3. POLICY COMPLIANCE & ACTIONS TAKEN:
In accordance with Fraud Policy v1.0 (Rules R6, R8, R9), the institution initiated immediate defensive card blocks, escalated the case to Senior Fraud Management (Level 2 Approval), and filed this formal FinCEN SAR.

evidence.claim: Device profile (Windows | Unknown | edge 16.0 | Unknown) is shared across 160 cards and 158 distinct customers, linked to 1164 historical fraud cases (CC-1747, CC-2404, CC-4581)

containment_steps: Immediate hard block on primary compromised card C09988-K1
Identify and freeze all companion cards sharing device profile across graph
Add device hardware fingerprint and proxy IP ranges to real-time blacklists
Revoke active web/mobile banking sessions for affected accounts

customer_communication.message_copy: Dear Cardholder, we detected unauthorized activity on your card ending in 8-K1. For your security, we have placed a hold on the card. A fraud specialist will contact you to reissue a new card.

financial_remediation: Issue provisional credit to affected cardholder(s)
Waive all associated late fees or overdraft charges
compliance_actions: File FinCEN Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) under Rule R9 (Organized Proxy Syndicate)
Escalate case dossier to Senior Fraud Operations & Legal Compliance (Level 2 Approval)
Write finalized investigation dossier and syndicate links back to TigerGraph
